text: 15 September 2026 The Mongolian Heritage Programme (MHP) brought heritage management learning into practice through a Field School in the Orkhon Valley Cultural Landscape (OVCL), a UNESCO World Heritage property, held from 2 to 7 September 2026. The Field School brought together 16 participants and two experts. Field visits and group exercises addressed community engagement, interpretation and education, tourism and visitor management, and disaster risk and climate action. The findings contribute to an Integrated Management Proposal for the cultural landscape.
